value.name: clarify office-line disclosure
value.description: Asha explains that the call is an acceptable place to disclose the family's position and remaining disagreements.
evidence: "We have agreed that we will not pretend, in your presence or in any other professional setting, that we have agreed about more than we have agreed about, and that we will bring our remaining disagreements to the table on Monday week rather than try to resolve them privately first. Is this — is this the kind of thing it is permissible to tell you on the office line."
"This is exactly the kind of thing it is permissible to tell me on the office line."

value.name: confirm permission to speak
value.description: Lucia confirms that Asha's disclosure is appropriate for the office line, and Asha acknowledges it.
evidence: "This is exactly the kind of thing it is permissible to tell me on the office line."

value.name: exchange thanks after disclosure
value.description: Asha thanks Lucia for listening, and Lucia responds that they wanted to tell her because of who she is.
evidence: "Thank you for being someone we wanted to tell."

value.name: end call with Lucia
value.description: Asha hangs up after the conversation about the house and the family's position.

value.name: revise agenda items
value.description: Asha sits for a long time and revises her agenda to reflect that the residence will be retained and financed rather than disposed of.
evidence: She sat at her desk for a long time.

She picked up the agenda she had drafted on Friday and she crossed out the third item, which had read "discussion of options re: disposition of the residence," and she wrote in its place, "discussion of structures for retention of the residence."
She crossed out the fourth item, which had read "discussion of timeline and any extensions required," and wrote in its place, "discussion of timeline and financing."

value.name: leave fifth agenda item unchanged
value.description: Asha keeps the fifth agenda item as originally drafted, implying only some parts of the plan need revision.
evidence: She left the fifth item as it was.

value.name: inform Marcus the house is staying
value.description: Asha calls Marcus and tells him that they are keeping the house.
evidence: "They are keeping the house," she said.
